lane_rules.speculative_actions: Guessed actions are allowed in lane C only and are labeled SPECULATIVE. They are exempt from the reverse-scaffold ban on unconstrained source-action recovery, but no lane-C result enters the constraint matrix or any ledger without re-derivation through lane B.
lane_rules.selection_within_lane: the active bet with the most remaining time box
lane_rules.winner_rule: A bet that moves a ledger row or a matrix cell (after lane-B re-derivation) receives the next freed time box.
lane_rules.kill_rule: A bet whose kill criterion is met, or whose time box runs out without a delta, is closed and recorded; it is never silently extended.
lane_rules.reroute_rule: Three consecutive zero-delta runs reroute the lane to the next active bet within the same Big Wave.
lane_rules.guess_budget: At most 3 guessed action variants per lane-C run, each chosen as a structural ansatz (a symmetry or representation family), never by tuning coefficients. A bet that needs more variants to make progress is killed by its time box, not extended.
